defects.title: CI installs Python 3.14.8 instead of the locked 3.14.6, so every model-loading unit test stops with ModelDeliveryError and CI is red on main
defects.steps:
1. Open GitHub > AlgoGuard-CSThesis/AlgoGuard > Actions > CI.
2. Open run 38886300881 (cb3bcdb) or 38870178965 (940e082), job 'checks'.
3. In 'Run actions/setup-python@v5' see 'python-version: 3.14' and 'Successfully set up CPython (3.14.8)'.
4. In 'Unit tests' see 40 errors and 4 failures with model_runtime.ModelDeliveryError.
defects.expected: CI runs on the locked runtime (requirements-model.lock / model_runtime.PYTHON_VERSION = 3.14.6, as the workflow comment itself says) and all steps are green.
defects.actual: Unit tests: '5 failed, 476 passed, 21 skipped, 34 deselected, 40 errors'; 44 of the 45 are ModelDeliveryError ('Install the locked Python model runtime.' x43 from model_runtime.py:38; 'Retrain this artifact with the locked model runtime.' x1 from model_runtime.py:74), because .github/workflows/ci.yml asks setup-python for '3.14' and gets 3.14.8. The remaining failure is DEF-03. Browser polling tests are then skipped. All six main runs since 2026-10-05 failed. The app's refusal of an unlocked runtime is by design; the defect is the unpinned CI Python version. Not reproduced on PC A: the working copy passes (537 passed), and so does a clean clone of cb3bcdb with a fresh Python 3.14.6 venv from requirements-dev.txt only (521 passed, 21 skipped, 34 deselected; exit 0; the 21 skips are 16 tests in test_maintainer_env.py and 5 integration modules that need psycopg2 from requirements-maintainer.txt, which CI does not install either), because PC A runs the locked 3.14.6.
defects.environment: GitHub Actions windows-latest; setup-python '3.14' (patch level not pinned; requirements-model.lock records 3.14.6); Node 22
defects.evidence: Test Log rows ENV-02.1 (13:00, 13:50); test-results/env_20261019/ci_run_38886300881_cb3bcdb_failed.log and ci_run_38870178965_940e082_failed.log; Automated Runs rows 'DEF-01 reproduction'; test-results/env_20261019/ci-repro.log, ci-repro-pytest.log, ci-repro-pytest-rs.log; CI runs https://github.com/AlgoGuard-CSThesis/AlgoGuard/actions/runs/38886300881 and .../38870178965

defects.title: test_cap_reserves_before_enqueue_and_retry_does_not_consume_slot fails on the CI runner: 300 queued outbox writes do not finish within drain()'s 5 s limit
defects.steps:
1. Open CI run 38886300881 (cb3bcdb) or 38870178965 (940e082), job 'checks', step 'Unit tests'.
2. Find tests/test_cloud_outbox.py::test_cap_reserves_before_enqueue_and_retry_does_not_consume_slot.
defects.expected: spool.drain() returns True after 300 events are queued (test line 55).
defects.actual: 'assert spool.drain()' -> False in both runs. Outbox.drain() waits at most 5 s (cloud_outbox.py:554-558) for the writer thread to persist the queue. Passes on PC A in the working copy and in the clean clone. The model runtime is not involved. Most likely the GitHub windows-latest runner writes the 300 SQLite rows more slowly than 5 s; not confirmed. It would keep CI red after DEF-01 is fixed.

defects.title: Deployed model misses the accuracy target on the independent evaluation set (81.47% vs >= 90%)
defects.steps:
1. On the build commit, with the venv active, run:
   python scripts/evaluate_model.py --model saved_models/run_3/stacking.joblib --compare-dir saved_models/run_3
2. The script removes every UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv row whose 15 features appear in datasets/*.csv and scores the rest (53,243 rows).
3. Read 'accuracy' in summary.md.
defects.actual: accuracy = 81.47% on 53,243 unseen rows (20,674 attack / 32,569 normal). Full result: accuracy 81.47%, F1 79.49%, recall 92.44%, FPR 25.49%, ROC-AUC 0.9371; FP 8,301 of 32,569 normal flows. The same model scores accuracy 96.98% / F1 97.77% / FPR 4.07% on algoguard_big.csv, the data it was trained on: a generalisation gap from training on a 5,000-row sample.
defects.environment: PC A (SANMIGUEL), Windows 11 Home 26H2 build 26300.9711, Python 3.14.6 venv; scikit-learn 1.9.0

defects.title: train.py uses every non-target column as a feature: on the raw UNSW-NB15 file it trains on attack_cat (the label) and id, reports 100%, and local --deploy has no feature-schema check
defects.steps:
1. Build a CSV with the UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv columns (e.g. the training file itself, or test-results/sys01_holdout/make_holdout.py's model_b_train.csv).
2. python train.py <that CSV> --models-dir saved_models/cycle1_B (no --deploy).
3. Read the comparison table and the artifact's feature_columns.
defects.expected: Training uses only the supported 15-feature flow schema (model_runtime FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION 'unsw-nb15-fifteen-v1'), or refuses a CSV with other columns; label-derived columns such as attack_cat are never features.
defects.actual: preprocessing_service.prepare_dataset() takes every column except the last as a feature: 44 features including attack_cat and id. Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, Naive Bayes and Stacking report 100.00% accuracy / F1 / ROC-AUC (Naive Bayes is 48.72% on 15 features). Cloud publication and download refuse such a model (model_runtime.verify_artifact_contract, called from publish_model.py and model_delivery.py), but the local deploy path (train.py _deploy_stacking -> deployment_service.deploy_model) does not call it - by code reading; --deploy was not run. Workaround: train only on CSVs with the 15 features + label, as the bundled datasets are.
defects.environment: PC A (SANMIGUEL), Windows 11 Home 26H2 build 26300.9711, Python 3.14.6 venv; local training run 5
defects.evidence: Test Log row SYS-01.5; test-results/sys01_holdout/train_B_console.log, eval_B_raw_console.log; services/preprocessing_service.py:158-219; model_runtime.py:69-77; train.py:130-200

defects.title: Local stack: supabase start exits 0 but leaves the crashed Edge Runtime stopped; Edge Function integration tests then fail with HTTP 503
defects.steps:
1. Let the supabase_edge_runtime_AlgoGuard container stop (here it had exited with code 255 eleven days earlier).
2. Run npx supabase start (CLI 2.117.0); it exits 0 and lists the Edge Runtime under 'Stopped services'.
3. Run python -m pytest -q -m integration.
defects.expected: supabase start brings up every service enabled in supabase/config.toml ([edge_runtime] enabled = true), or fails; the integration lane passes.
defects.actual: Exit 0 with the Edge Runtime still stopped; 5 integration tests fail with HTTP 503 'name resolution failed' from /functions/v1/account_admin. Workaround: docker start supabase_edge_runtime_AlgoGuard, then the lane passes (65 passed, 2 skipped). The same stopped Edge Runtime was noted in 05f-pilot.md section 8.2 (2026-09-30). Test-environment issue; the product is not affected.
defects.environment: PC A (SANMIGUEL), Windows 11 Home 26H2 build 26300.9711, Python 3.14.6 venv; Docker Desktop 29.8.0; Supabase CLI 2.117.0 local stack
